'''Doom Droid''' was an [[isotope-5 droid]] designed on [[Makeb]]. At some point during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] the droid was obtained by the [[Eternal Empire]] and brought to [[Zakuul]]. The droid underwent modifications, which allowed it to be piloted by a Human mind instead of a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]]. In [[3630 BBY]] the mind of [[Arlaia Zayzen]], a recently defeated gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]], was snatched from the clutches of death and uploaded into the Doom Droid. With a new, completely robotic body, Zayzen tried to claim her revenge against "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]," but was defeated in round nine of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doom Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the ninth boss of the "Eternal Championship".<ref name="SWTOR" />
